verdict.honest_reading: Third promotion attempt. On fresh MIXED-CAUSAL-v5 the v5 policy (114/180) exactly tied always-normalize (114) with LOWER cost (113 vs 180), fewer regressions (1 vs 2), and significantly beat every other baseline including the best simple rule (+5.6pp, p=0.011). But the strict preregistered criterion requires beating EVERY fixed policy, and a tie is not a win. Per-family gaps on selection/realization/no_intervention persist though smaller than v4. Verdict: the learned policy now MATCHES the best constant at lower cost - genuine progress from v4's significant loss - but 'matches a constant' is not 'learned intervention selection'.
